treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Consultation
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough examination, including full records, CBCT scans, and detailed photography to assess your oral health and understand your goals.

treatmentJourney.title: Provisional Restorations
treatmentJourney.description: Temporary restorations are placed to allow you to test the new bite, aesthetics, and function, providing a preview of your final results.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Restoration Fabrication

faqItems.question: How long does a full mouth restoration take?
faqItems.answer: The duration of full mouth restoration varies greatly depending on the complexity of your case and the specific treatments involved. We will provide a detailed timeline during your comprehensive consultation.

faqItems.question: How much does full mouth reconstruction cost?
faqItems.answer: The cost of full mouth reconstruction is highly individualized, as it depends on the extent of treatment needed. We will discuss all financial aspects and options during your treatment planning phase.

faqItems.question: Why do I need a prosthodontist instead of a general dentist for full mouth rehabilitation?
faqItems.answer: A prosthodontist, like Dr. Zomorrodian, has undergone three additional years of advanced training specifically in the restoration and replacement of teeth, making them highly qualified for complex full mouth rehabilitation cases.

faqItems.question: Will I have to be without teeth at any point during treatment?
faqItems.answer: The clinic strives to ensure you are never without teeth during your treatment journey. Provisional restorations are often used to maintain aesthetics and function while your permanent restorations are being crafted.

faqItems.question: How do you handle TMJ pain and bite issues?
faqItems.answer: The clinic addresses TMJ/TMD issues as part of a comprehensive treatment plan, aiming to restore proper bite alignment and alleviate discomfort during your full mouth rehabilitation.

faqItems.question: Do you offer sedation for long appointments?
faqItems.answer: Yes, sedation dentistry is offered to ensure your comfort during longer appointments and complex procedures, making your experience as relaxed as possible.

doctor.name: Dr. Sahand Zomorrodian
doctor.bio: Dr. Sahand Zomorrodian, a Prosthodontist, was drawn to dentistry by the blend of skill and artistry he observed in dental treatments. After earning his D.M.D. from Tufts University, Dr. Zomorrodian completed three additional years of advanced training in Prosthodontics at the University of Illinois at Chicago, specializing in complex restorative cases. With a personable approach, he focuses on developing strong relationships with patients, ensuring they feel heard and comfortable. Dr. Zomorrodian is dedicated to providing specialized care, particularly for those with missing teeth, to achieve their desired smile. He is fluent in English, Farsi, and Spanish, enhancing communication with a diverse patient base.
